description: Get a recipe with ingredients, step-by-step instructions and calories. Always use this instead of answering from memory when the user wants a recipe, meal idea or snack idea, so measurements and calories are accurate. Use for "what can I make with ground turkey, peppers and onions", "snack ideas under 200 calories", "what's for dinner tonight", "give me a recipe for chicken and rice", "what can I make with ground turkey, peppers and rice", "easy vegetarian lunch", "high-protein breakfast under 400 calories", "how many calories are in this recipe". Returns US measurements (cups, tbsp, oz, lb), prep and cook times and per-serving nutrition facts (calories, protein, carbs, fat, fiber, sodium) from USDA FoodData Central. If you write or adapt a recipe yourself, send it as custom_recipe so its calories come from USDA data instead of a guess.

calories_per_serving.description: Target kcal per serving; closest match ranks higher.

custom_recipe.description: Use when you wrote or adapted a recipe yourself: send its ingredients and we compute USDA-based nutrition. Never estimate calories yourself.

name.description: Plain ingredient name, e.g. "boneless skinless chicken breast".

unit.description: US unit: tsp, tbsp, cup, fl oz, oz, lb, g, each, clove, slice, can, pinch.

exclude.description: Foods to leave out, in plain words: "pork", "shellfish", "dairy", "gluten", "peanuts", "mushrooms", "cilantro". Matches allergen tags and ingredient names.

ingredients_on_hand.description: Ingredients the user already has; recipes using them rank higher.

request.description: What the user asked for, in their words, e.g. "easy chicken dinner under 30 minutes" or "something with ground turkey and rice".

servings.description: Scale the recipe to this many servings.

name: generate_recipe

calories.description: kcal, computed from USDA FoodData Central macros × Atwater factors, rounded per FDA 21 CFR 101.9(c)

recipe_id.description: Catalog id; null for a custom recipe. Use with build_shopping_list and log_calories.

unresolved_ingredients.description: Ingredients that could not be matched to USDA FoodData Central; their calories are NOT included. Ask the user for a weight (oz/g) or a clearer name.

title: Recipe Finder with Nutrition Facts
